messages:
maria: Heads-up — after the kernel-selection change (patch #438), we're seeing sporadic ~40-120ms tail spikes at 10k QPS on the replay harness when KV-prefetch is enabled. Repro rate ~12% on nightly replay. Attaching quick perf snippet.

devon: Can you paste the small log snippet? Also which model / seq len?

maria: Model: redwood-vicuna-7b, seq=512 (mostly). Quick log excerpt below:

```
2026-03-01T20:12:01Z SERVED tenant=acme batch_size=16 kernel=matmul_opt dispatch_delay=5ms total=98ms
2026-03-01T20:12:01Z SERVED tenant=acme batch_size=8 kernel=matmul_fallback dispatch_delay=0ms total=170ms
2026-03-01T20:12:02Z WARN   kernel_swap mid-request kernel=matmul_opt->matmul_fallback reason=quant_param_mismatch
2026-03-01T20:12:02Z KV_PREFETCH hit_rate=0.78 eviction_ms=3.2
```

kai: Hmm, looks like a mid-request kernel swap. That likely explains the jank. Could be the selector switching when prefetch latency bumps. Eviction_ms of 3.2 is suspicious under microbursts.

perf-bot: perf-bot: automated profile summary available — delta vs baseline: +22% time in kernel_dispatch path, userland scheduling jitter +18ms p95, KV-cache hit-rate down 8% under synthetic microburst. Flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/reports/1778888888/flame.html

devon: We need apples-to-apples. Proposal: run these experiment arms and capture pprof + kv prefetch histograms:
A) replay harness (nightly) on master (baseline)
B) replay harness with kernel-selection disabled (force-opt)
C) synthetic Poisson arrivals matching replay inter-arrival distribution, cold KV (warmup=0)
D) synthetic Poisson, warm KV (prefetch primed), both with same seed.

Also capture: batch_delay_cap, batch_size_cap, and kernel_dispatch timings.

maria: I'll run A/B this afternoon on the 4-node dev cluster. Config I'm using below (won't paste full infra):

```
{
  "harness": "replay",
  "model": "redwood-vicuna-7b",
  "seq_len": 512,
  "qps_target": 10000,
  "batch_delay_cap_ms": 0.5,
  "batch_size_cap": 32,
  "kv_prefetch": true
}
```

kai: I'll generate the synthetic traces (C/D) with the same arrival hist and KV-state snapshot. Quick reminder flags: `--profile-hotpath`, `--capture-pprof=kernel_dispatch` and `--kv-hist` to collect eviction/hit histograms. I suspect eviction thrashing + kernel swap race.

devon: If we reproduce, revert the kernel selector gating on release branch and cut a canary while we dig in. Also check prefix-cache size influence.

maria: Noted. small data point: I saw more spikes when prefix cache size < 8MB. Might be a tuning knob to try.

perf-bot: perf-bot: created artifact /buckets/perf/repro-1778888888/summary.json

maria: I'll upload raw traces + pprofs to /buckets/perf/repro-1778888888/ after runs. Assigning DRI: maria.

devon: Thanks. Quick sync tomorrow in #performance-review to decide rollback vs fix. :thumbsup:

kai: On it, starting synthetic generation now :eyes:

maria: Thanks all — will report back with numbers and a minimal repro script. :+1:
